title: Apply for a pawnbroker licence
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a pawnbroker licence, which is required to lend money to people who give goods as security for a loan.
intro:
You need a pawnbroker licence to lend money to people who give you goods as security for the loan.

To buy or sell second-hand goods you also need a second-hand dealer licence.

You can apply for a 1, 3 or 5-year licence as an individual or corporation and get a:
who_can_apply: Be a 'fit and proper person' to hold a licence.
Not be a controlled member of a declared criminal organisation.
If applying as a corporation, the corporation must be a 'fit and proper person' and not a disqualified person.
Each corporation director must be a 'fit and proper person'.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for a Licence Under the Pawnbrokers and Second-Hand Dealers Act'.
Your details and the details of the corporation, directors, or business partner (if applicable).
Your business address and contact details.
Payment for the licence application fee.
Proof of identity (such as driver licence or passport).

faqs.q: Do I need a licence to buy or sell second-hand goods?
faqs.a: Yes, if you buy or sell second-hand goods, you also need a second-hand dealer licence.

faqs.q: What are the eligibility requirements for a pawnbroker licence?
faqs.a: Applicants must be aged 18 or over, be a 'fit and proper person', and not be a disqualified person or controlled member of a declared criminal organisation. If applying as a corporation, the corporation and all directors must meet these criteria.

faqs.q: How do I pay the licence application fee?
faqs.a: You can pay the fee online using a credit card or PayPal and enter the receipt number on the PDF form. Alternatively, you can pay at a service centre, but some do not accept cash.
